newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau activists to hire choppers to land on isles.
newsitem.headline: Macau activists to hire choppers to land on isles.

text.p: A group of Macau activists said on Wednesday they planned to hire two helicopters to drop their colleagues on uninhabited rocky outcrops in the East China Sea to show Chinese sovereignty over them.
Group leader Lo Sio, a Macau real estate agent and karaoke bar owner, said activists who land on the isles would stay there for several days to support China's claim to the islands.

A protest movement has spiralled in Chinese communities in East Asia since Japanese extremists in July erected a lighthouse and planted flags on the islands, which China calls the Diaoyus and Japan calls the Senkakus.
